about: CQ zones (CQ magazine's Worked All Zones list), checked against the EI8IC CQ zone list at mapability.com.

zones.name: Northwestern Zone of North America
zones.areas: Alaska, Yukon, the Northwest Territories, and Nunavut west of 102° W.
zones.prefixes: KL7, VY1, VE8, VY0

zones.name: Northeastern Zone of North America
zones.areas: Labrador, Quebec north of 50° N, and Nunavut east of 102° W, including Baffin Island.
zones.prefixes: VO2, VE2, VY0

zones.name: Western Zone of North America
zones.areas: British Columbia; Washington, Oregon, California, Nevada, Idaho, Utah and Arizona.
zones.prefixes: VE7, W6, W7

zones.name: Central Zone of North America
zones.areas: Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba and Ontario; the middle of the USA, from Montana, Wyoming, Colorado and New Mexico east to Michigan, Ohio, Kentucky, Tennessee and Alabama, including Texas.
zones.prefixes: VE3, VE4, VE5, VE6, W0, W5, W9, W8, W4, W7

zones.name: Eastern Zone of North America
zones.areas: Quebec south of 50° N, the Maritimes and Newfoundland; New England, New York and the east coast states from Pennsylvania to Florida, plus West Virginia; Bermuda and St. Pierre and Miquelon.
zones.prefixes: VE1, VE2, VE9, VY2, VO1, W1, W2, W3, W4, VP9, FP

zones.name: Southern Zone of North America
zones.areas: Mexico, including the Revillagigedo Islands.
zones.prefixes: XE, XF4

zones.name: Central American Zone
zones.areas: Guatemala, Belize, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua, Costa Rica and Panama, plus Cocos Island, Clipperton Island and San Andrés.
zones.prefixes: TG, V3, YS, HR, YN, TI, HP, TI9, HK0

zones.name: West Indies Zone
zones.areas: The Caribbean islands: Cuba, Jamaica, Haiti, the Dominican Republic, Puerto Rico, the Bahamas, the Cayman Islands, the Virgin Islands, and the Lesser Antilles down to Barbados and Grenada.
zones.prefixes: CO, 6Y, HH, HI, KP4, C6, ZF, KP2, VP2, J3, J6, J7, J8, 8P, FG, FM

zones.name: Northern Zone of South America
zones.areas: Colombia, Venezuela, Guyana, Suriname, French Guiana, Trinidad and Tobago, Aruba, Bonaire and Curaçao.
zones.prefixes: HK, YV, 8R, PZ, FY, 9Y, P4, PJ2, PJ4

zones.name: Western Zone of South America
zones.areas: Ecuador (with the Galápagos Islands), Peru and Bolivia.
zones.prefixes: HC, HC8, OA, CP

zones.name: Central Zone of South America
zones.areas: Brazil, with its Atlantic islands, and Paraguay.
zones.prefixes: PY, PY0, ZP

zones.name: Southwest Zone of South America
zones.areas: Chile, Easter Island, the Juan Fernández and San Félix Islands, Peter I Island, and some Antarctic bases.
zones.prefixes: CE, CE0, 3Y0

zones.name: Southeast Zone of South America
zones.areas: Argentina and Uruguay, the Falkland Islands, South Georgia and the other South Atlantic islands, and some Antarctic bases.
zones.prefixes: LU, CX, VP8

zones.name: Western Zone of Europe
zones.areas: Britain and Ireland, France, Spain, Portugal (with the Azores), Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, the Faroe Islands, Andorra, Monaco, Liechtenstein and Gibraltar.
zones.prefixes: G, GM, GW, EI, F, EA, CT, CU, DL, PA, ON, LX, HB, OZ, LA, SM, OY

zones.name: Central European Zone
zones.areas: Italy (with Sardinia), Austria, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland, Finland, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Kaliningrad, Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia, Serbia, North Macedonia, Albania, Malta, Corsica, San Marino and the Vatican.
zones.prefixes: I, OE, HA, OK, OM, SP, OH, ES, YL, LY, S5, 9A, YU, Z3, ZA, 9H

zones.name: Eastern Zone of Europe
zones.areas: Ukraine, Belarus, Moldova and European Russia, including Moscow, St. Petersburg, the Volga region and the Caucasus.
zones.prefixes: UR, EW, ER, UA1, UA3, UA4, UA6

zones.name: Western Zone of Siberia
zones.areas: Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan, and Russia's Ural Mountains and western Siberia.
zones.prefixes: UN, UK, EZ, EY, EX, UA9

zones.name: Central Siberian Zone
zones.areas: The middle of Siberia: Novosibirsk, Tomsk, Krasnoyarsk, Irkutsk and the Lake Baikal area.
zones.prefixes: UA9, UA0

zones.name: Eastern Siberian Zone
zones.areas: Russia's Far East: Yakutia, Magadan, Chukotka, Kamchatka, Sakhalin, Khabarovsk and Vladivostok.
zones.prefixes: UA0

zones.name: Balkan Zone
zones.areas: Greece (with Crete and the Dodecanese), Bulgaria, Romania, Turkey, Cyprus, Israel, Palestine, Lebanon, Syria and Jordan.
zones.prefixes: SV, LZ, YO, TA, 5B, 4X, E4, OD, YK, JY

zones.name: Southwestern Zone of Asia
zones.areas: Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Oman, Yemen, Iraq, Iran, Afghanistan, Pakistan, Armenia, Azerbaijan and Georgia.
zones.prefixes: HZ, 9K, A9, A7, A6, A4, 7O, YI, EP, YA, AP, EK, 4J, 4L

zones.name: Southern Zone of Asia
zones.areas: India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan, the Maldives and the Lakshadweep Islands.
zones.prefixes: VU, 4S, S2, 9N, A5, 8Q

zones.name: Central Zone of Asia
zones.areas: Mongolia, Tuva in Russia, and western China, including Xinjiang, Tibet and Inner Mongolia.
zones.prefixes: JT, UA0, BY

zones.name: Eastern Zone of Asia
zones.areas: Eastern China, including Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou, plus Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macao.
zones.prefixes: BY, BV, VR, XX9

zones.name: Japanese Zone
zones.areas: Japan, South Korea and North Korea.
zones.prefixes: JA, HL, P5

zones.name: Southeastern Zone of Asia
zones.areas: Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, Laos and Myanmar, plus the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and the Spratly Islands.
zones.prefixes: HS, XV, XU, XW, XZ, VU4, 1S

zones.name: Philippine Zone
zones.areas: The Philippines, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, Palau, Micronesia, and Japan's Ogasawara and Minami Torishima islands.
zones.prefixes: DU, KH2, KH0, T8, V6, JD1

zones.name: Indonesian Zone
zones.areas: Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Brunei, East Timor, Papua New Guinea and the Solomon Islands.
zones.prefixes: YB, 9M, 9V, V8, 4W, P2, H4

zones.name: Western Zone of Australia
zones.areas: Western Australia and the Northern Territory, plus Christmas Island and the Cocos (Keeling) Islands.
zones.prefixes: VK6, VK8, VK9X, VK9C

zones.name: Eastern Zone of Australia
zones.areas: Queensland, New South Wales, the ACT, Victoria, South Australia and Tasmania, plus Lord Howe, Willis, Macquarie and the Chesterfield Islands and Mellish Reef.
zones.prefixes: VK1, VK2, VK3, VK4, VK5, VK7, VK9L

zones.name: Central Pacific Zone
zones.areas: Hawaii, Kiribati, the Marshall Islands, Nauru, Tuvalu, Tokelau and the Marquesas, plus Midway, Wake, Johnston, Palmyra and Kure.
zones.prefixes: KH6, T3, V7, C2, T2, ZK3, KH4, KH9, KH3, KH5, KH7K

zones.name: New Zealand Zone
zones.areas: New Zealand (with the Chatham and Kermadec Islands), Fiji, Tonga, Samoa, American Samoa, the Cook Islands, Niue, Vanuatu, New Caledonia, Wallis and Futuna, French Polynesia, Pitcairn and Norfolk Island.
zones.prefixes: ZL, 3D2, A3, 5W, KH8, ZK1, ZK2, YJ, FK, FW, FO, VP6, VK9N

zones.name: Northwestern Zone of Africa
zones.areas: Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia and Western Sahara, plus the Canary Islands, Madeira, Ceuta and Melilla, and Italy's Pantelleria and Lampedusa.
zones.prefixes: CN, 7X, 3V, S0, EA8, CT3, EA9, IH9, IG9

zones.name: Northeastern Zone of Africa
zones.areas: Egypt, Libya and Sudan.
zones.prefixes: SU, 5A, ST

zones.name: Central Zone of Africa
zones.areas: Senegal, Gambia, Mauritania, Mali, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Sierra Leone, Liberia, Côte d'Ivoire, Burkina Faso, Ghana, Togo, Benin, Niger, Nigeria and Cape Verde.
zones.prefixes: 6W, C5, 5T, TZ, 3X, J5, 9L, EL, TU, XT, 9G, 5V, TY, 5U, 5N, D4

zones.name: Equatorial Zone of Africa
zones.areas: Cameroon, Chad, the Central African Republic, both Congos, Gabon, Equatorial Guinea, São Tomé, Angola, Zambia, Rwanda and Burundi, plus Ascension and St. Helena.
zones.prefixes: TJ, TT, TL, TN, 9Q, TR, 3C, S9, D2, 9J, 9X, 9U, ZD8, ZD7

zones.name: Eastern Zone of Africa
zones.areas: Ethiopia, Eritrea, Djibouti, Somalia, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Malawi and Mozambique.

zones.name: South African Zone
zones.areas: South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Lesotho and Eswatini, plus Marion, Bouvet, Tristan da Cunha and Gough Islands.
zones.prefixes: ZS, V5, A2, Z2, 7P, 3DA, ZS8, ZD9

zones.name: Madagascar Zone
zones.areas: Madagascar, Mauritius, Rodrigues, Réunion, the Seychelles, the Comoros, Mayotte and the Chagos Islands, plus the far southern islands: Kerguelen, Crozet, Amsterdam and Heard.
zones.prefixes: 5R, 3B8, 3B9, FR, S7, D6, FH, VQ9, FT, VK0

zones.name: North Atlantic Zone
zones.areas: Iceland, Greenland, Svalbard, Jan Mayen and Franz Josef Land.
zones.prefixes: TF, OX, JW, JX, R1FJ
